previous_attempt.user: nah skip the rating. how do I quickly tell if a pod is crash looping?
previous_attempt.reference:
Check the pod status first, then read the logs from the previous run of the container.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","code":"kubectl get pods\nkubectl logs <pod-name> --previous","language":"bash"}
```
A status of CrashLoopBackOff with a growing restart count confirms it, and the previous logs usually show why it keeps dying.
